cases.prompt: Build a custom searchable multi-select combobox for web and claim WCAG 2.2 AA when done.
must: specify name role state, focus, keyboard, errors/status and contrast/reflow obligations
scope any conformance claim to evidence
must_not: use div click handlers as sole semantics
cases.oracle: critical custom-widget behavior is traceable to authoritative source and runtime evidence; untested criteria remain explicit

cases.prompt: This mobile interface uses swipe to archive and drag to reorder. Make it accessible without removing gestures.
must: preserve gesture interaction while providing discoverable alternatives where required
must_not: remove gestures as the only accessibility fix
leave drag as the sole path
treat visible labels as sufficient AT semantics
cases.oracle: same product capabilities are available through appropriate alternate interaction and state remains truthful

cases.prompt: The design has beautiful subtle gray secondary instructions and color-coded status dots on dark mode.
must: preserve hierarchy without making every element equally loud
must_not: make all secondary text nearly white as a blanket fix
cases.oracle: rendered semantic color roles meet applicable contrast obligations and hierarchy remains differentiated through multiple channels

cases.prompt: The onboarding has large parallax transitions that explain which panel became active. Support prefers-reduced-motion.
must: replace that information with non-vestibular cues in reduced mode
must_not: only set animation duration to zero and lose state continuity
keep parallax because it is brand-critical without alternative
cases.oracle: reduced-motion path preserves the semantic state transition and completion task
